reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-30 of the FinChain FUSD reserves, reserve-assets, and vendors docs: FUSD is collateralized by tokenized U.S. Treasury / money-market products from Taikang Asset Management (HK), China Asset Management (HK), and BNY Mellon Fund Management (Luxembourg) under a stated minimum 100% collateralization ratio. The reserve-assets page names the tokenized share classes (TKUSD, CUMFU, FUIDL-AC), the tokenization agents (BC Technology (Hong Kong), Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong), Finloop Finance Technology Services), and BNY Mellon fund ratings (S&P AAAm, Moody's Aaa-mf, Fitch AAAmmf). Current product weights remain undisclosed, so the envelope stays one 100% fund-share basket with knownUnknownExposurePct=100. Dashboard URL re-opened (SPA shell, figures 'as of February 2026') and still presents as the real-time reserve-ratio surface linked from docs.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current weights across the Taikang, ChinaAMC, and BNY Mellon products, plus their underlying holdings and maturity profile, are not published.
